**Meta Platforms**
- FY2023 revenue: $134,902M; FY2024 revenue: $164,501M [DOC-1]
- Growth: ($164,501 − $134,902) / $134,902 = $29,599 / $134,902 = **+21.94%**

**Amazon.com**
- FY2023 net sales: $574,785M; FY2024 net sales: $637,959M [DOC-1]
- Growth: ($637,959 − $574,785) / $574,785 = $63,174 / $574,785 = **+10.99%**

**Difference:** 21.94% − 10.99% = **10.95 percentage points**, with Meta growing faster. (Note the scale difference: Amazon added ~$63.2B of absolute revenue versus Meta's ~$29.6B [DOC-1], so Meta's faster percentage growth reflects its smaller revenue base.)

ANSWER: Meta grew faster, by approximately 10.95 percentage points (Meta +21.94% vs. Amazon +10.99%)
